breakpoints.use: windowClasses holds the window class thresholds. The viewport breakpoints are gone: envUI responds to containers at window classes, compact below 37.5 rem, medium from 37.5, expanded from 52.5 and large from 75, so write @container env-window (width >= 37.5rem) in a style sheet over a compact default, and let Scaffold and Panes switch their arrangement themselves.

Breakpoint.use: WindowClass names a window class. The viewport breakpoints are gone: envUI responds to containers at window classes, compact below 37.5 rem, medium from 37.5, expanded from 52.5 and large from 75, so write @container env-window (width >= 37.5rem) in a style sheet over a compact default, and let Scaffold and Panes switch their arrangement themselves.

useBreakpoint.use: The viewport breakpoints are gone: envUI responds to containers at window classes, compact below 37.5 rem, medium from 37.5, expanded from 52.5 and large from 75, so write @container env-window (width >= 37.5rem) in a style sheet over a compact default, and let Scaffold and Panes switch their arrangement themselves. No hook reads the width: arrange content in CSS.

useMediaQuery.use: useMediaQuery is gone: query widths with container queries in CSS, at the window classes of the env-window container, and other media features with matchMedia or an @media rule of your own.

MediaQueryOptions.use: useMediaQuery is gone, with its options: query widths with container queries in CSS.
